about: The cheapest model that does each recurring job well. One row per kind of job, never per brand. Prices are list prices read on prices_read; the job ledger (meter.py) and each tool's own meter show what was actually spent.
rule: The owner's own plan pays only for the top tier: studying great content and the final writing pass. Everything that runs on a clock is code (no model) or the cheapest tier that holds the job's own check. A job moves up a tier only when its check fails on the cheaper one, recorded in the ledger.
